notes: Run 1 (2026-10-31) covers the statistical regions Osrednjeslovenska, Gorenjska, Primorsko-notranjska, Obalno-kraška and Goriška; the eastern regions (Podravska, Pomurska, Savinjska, Koroška, Zasavska, Posavska, Jugovzhodna Slovenija) follow in the next run (the VZB register already lists them). Poison line: no animal poison information line found for Slovenia — the national toxicology centre (UKC Ljubljana) serves humans; the Veterinary Faculty small-animal clinic's poisoning FAQ (kmz.si) only tells owners to call a vet urgently, so use the 24-h clinics. National context: since a rulebook change (Uradni list 8 July 2026) private clinics are no longer obliged to run 24-h duty; the ministry (gov.si, 24 July 2026) says emergency help stays guaranteed via the public veterinary network but publishes no duty list, and no VZB/UVHVVR duty-rota page exists. Not verified / left: Bled and Kranjska Gora have no registered practice (nearest Lesce, Jesenice); own sites not opened (robots/bot check/redirect loop): vpt.si (Tenetiše, robots), vpp.si, obutitacek.si, veterinacerknica.si, halovet.si, veterina-idrija.si, elbivet.si, veterinarska-postaja.si; Diagnoza duty number conflicts between site and register; Klinika Loka's role in the Gorenjska rota is inferred ("kolegi iz Škofje Loke"), not stated by name. Run 2 (2026-10-31, west follow-up) added the leftover practices (Animavet, Emir kirurgija, Klinkon, Rex, NOE, Dobro ×2, Gaber, VP Litija, Capriola/Zapuže, Cvenkel, Etvetera, KŽK ×2, Medicus, VPT Tenetiše, A-VET Sežana, Fiziovet, VA Idrija PE Cerkno) plus Dr.Vet, Veterina Dora, Šekli & Kukovica, VA Dobrepolje, VA Zavetišče Horjul and the Ljubljana animal eye clinic; Jata (Domžale, Pivka — poultry) and Veterina Marc Lipica (horses) kept as small_animals: false. Left out: VA Vanja Knez (register only, species unknown), Veterina Marc Lokev (not on its site). Conflicts: NOE register address/phone differ from its own site (site used); Veterina Dobro Grosuplje register phone 051 302 835 vs site 01 786 31 70 (site used). Blocked sites in run 2: animavet.si, va-medicus.si, vpt.si, veterina-idrija.si (register/itis.siol.net used). Farm-only/institutional units (MORS, police dog unit, VOA, VA Preska, LuxEquine) intentionally omitted.
